prompt: Review the file structure of this feature folder. We have: UserBadge/index.ts, UserBadge/UserBadge.view.tsx (just JSX), UserBadge/UserBadge.logic.ts (40 lines), UserBadge/UserBadge.styles.ts, UserBadge/types.ts. Each file is small and single-purpose. Is this a good layout for a codebase where we use AI assistants heavily?
assertions: Concludes the layout is over-split for an AI-heavy codebase
Recommends merging tightly-coupled view+logic+types into one component file
Identifies the dumb-view-props-shaped-by-sibling smell (cross-file context the agent won't fetch)
Keeps genuinely isolatable styles as a defensible separate file (does not blanket-merge everything)
